body:
## Summary

A 128-reviewer source audit of the 408 Lean modules under `spec/proofs/BitcoinProofs` found **185 issues: 1 critical, 46 high, 50 medium, 88 low**. 36 reviewers reported no new findings. The 9 static gates still pass; this was a source-level review, not a full package rebuild.

This issue tracks the actionable items. Items marked **confirmed** were re-read directly in the source; the rest are reviewer-reported and should be confirmed before patching. Some findings overlap with existing disclosures in `docs/RESIDUALS.md` and `docs/PROOF-BUILD.md`; where a residual is accepted as-is, close the checkbox with a link to that residual instead of changing the model.

## Critical

- [x] **Y08/Y09 SIGHASH_SINGLE overflow constant is wrong.** `Property/Y08/SighashLegacyProps.lean:99` defines `one256` as 32×`0x01`, but `Bitcoin.SigHash.singleOverflowOneB` is `0x01` followed by 31 zero bytes. The `b00`–`b04`/`d11` rows at `:442-466,831,1417` fail under `native_decide` (reproduced with `lake env lean`). Same mismatch at `Property/Y09/Property.lean:4401`. **Confirmed.**

## High — confirmed in source

- [x] **BIP113 median uses lower median.** `spec/core/Bitcoin/Block/Pow.lean:236` uses `(n-1)/2`; Core `chain.h:233-244` uses `n/2` (upper for even counts). Update `medianTimePast`, `Bip/B07/Bip113MTP.lean` fixtures, and the `mtp_even_count_lower_median` expectations.
- [x] **BIP141 `castToBool` ignores negative zero.** `Bip/B08/Bip141Defs.lean:54` uses `bytes.any (· != 0)`; Core treats `[0x00,0x80]` as false. Port Core's loop or reuse `Bitcoin.Numeric.castToBool`.
- [x] **`findAndDelete` corrupts scripts after any match.** `spec/core/Bitcoin/Interpreter/Defs.lean:548-564`: `fdLastPc2` returns the pre-match `pc2`, so the final `script.extract pc2 script.size` re-appends a suffix. `AF/PDW59/PDW59d.lean` discloses only the whole-tail case. Fix `fdLastPc2` to return the post-match `pc'`.
- [x] **CVE-2012-2459 detector flags unaligned duplicates.** `spec/core/Bitcoin/Block/Connect.lean:220-223` checks every adjacent pair; Core checks only pair-aligned `hashes[2i]==hashes[2i+1]`, so `[A,B,B]` is over-rejected. Update `merkleMutationFree` and the PDW12/PDW53 characterizations.
- [x] **Witness commitment uses a zero reserved value.** `spec/core/Bitcoin/Capstone/Merkle.lean:187-195` hashes `zeroBytes 32`, not the coinbase witness reserved value. `witnessCommitmentOkReserved` exists in `AF/PDW13/WitnessCommitmentReserved.lean` but is orphaned; `commitmentGate` still uses the old definition. Wire the corrected definition through and re-prove BLK-017/SWT-030/PDW58B.
- [x] **`validateBlock` omits the BIP30 gate.** `spec/core/Bitcoin/Capstone/Block.lean:382` calls `applyTxs` without `bip30BlockCollision`/`bip30Enforced`; `applyBlockL` does include it. Add the gate or route through `applyBlockL`, then update `CapstoneComposePipeline`.
- [x] **Taproot commitment is program-blind.** `spec/core/Bitcoin/Crypto/Taproot/Verify.lean:89-90` drops `program`; `OutputKey.outputKeyOk` checks only parity. Add Core's `q == program` / `CheckTapTweak` check and a wrong-program negative test; update `Audit/Z29`.
- [x] **Z21 EVAL_FALSE tests are false.** `Audit/Z21/Audit.lean:174,182` use `evalScriptBytes`, which never applies final-stack truthiness. Use `verifyScriptFull`/`executeWitnessScript`, and fix `"018000"` to `"028000"` if a two-byte push is intended.
- [x] **`native_decide` in a non-Test module.** `Property/Y03/Property.lean:326-522` has 72 `native_decide` proofs, contradicting the header's kernel-`decide` claim. Convert to `decide` or move to a Test/experiment module.
- [x] **Wallet selection determinism is tautological.** `Wallet/Spend/Selection.lean:115-135`: `largestFirst_deterministic`, `smallestFit_deterministic`, and `runSelection_deterministic` are all `f x = f x`. Replace with a real specification or remove.
- [x] **Wallet hash-lock acceptance is vacuous.** `Wallet/Miniscript/Interp.lean:1233`: `hproduce` requires `bytes [0,0,0,0]`, but the dissatisfaction is 32 zero bytes, so no hash fragment can satisfy it. Use `bytes (List.replicate 32 0)`.
- [x] **Merkle 64-shape matrix omits n=64.** `Theorems/Exhaust/MerkleShapes64.lean:147` iterates `List.range 64` (0..63), while `expectedRoot` covers 1..64. Iterate `k+1` or otherwise include n=64.
- [x] **`blockWeight_witness_discount` has the hypothesis reversed.** `AF/PDW51/PDW51.lean:103` assumes `totalSize ≤ strippedSize`; witness-bearing blocks have `stripped ≤ total`. State `4*stripped + (total - stripped)` instead.
- [x] **SmallCurve interface is uninhabited.** `SmallCurve/TweakCorSmall.lean:235`: `mulP_noneE` quantifies all `Nat k`, but `mulP'` only uses 16 bits. Restrict to `k < 2^16` or extend `mulP'`; otherwise the main theorems are vacuous.
- [x] **`PubKeyCor` has a non-Lean placeholder and missing U2 results.** `EcdsaDeep/PubKeyCor.lean:192` contains `Bool.eq_true mp_eq??`; `:128` is malformed; the header's U2 declarations do not exist. Fix U1, then either add U2 or remove the claims.
- [x] **O07 hash-op examples are false.** `Theorems/Ops/O07.lean:415-442` expects the hashed element to remain on the stack, while `opHash_effect` pops it. This is in a disclosed failing module, but the statements themselves are wrong.
- [x] **`FuelStability` lacks its advertised results.** `Theorems/FuelStability.lean` ends after `stepBody_pushBytes`; none of the FUEL-STAB/FUEL-CAN theorems or pins exist, and the §B proof is malformed. Complete the module or remove the claims from the module/release notes.
- [x] **`ScriptExact`/`Expand` totality claims are tautologies.** `Wallet/Miniscript/ScriptExact.lean:261` proves `∃ s, toScript ctx n = s`; `Wallet/Desc/Expand.lean:618,623` prove `f d p = f d p` and `∃ r, f d p = r`. Either remove or replace with substantive characterizations.

## High — reviewer-reported (confirm before patching)

- [x] **P2SH/witness sigop counting is not Core's.** `AF/PDW29/PDW29Sigops.lean:176-178` uses flat-20 `legacySigOpCountScript`/`sigOpScan`, omitting push-only and accurate P2WSH handling. Reuse `accurateSigOpCount`/`countWitnessSigOps`.
- [x] **`workOf`/`compactNegative` gate is wrong.** `AF/PDW24/PDW24.lean:89,44`: `compactNegative` tests the unshifted mantissa, and `workOf` adds a powLimit gate Core does not have. Align with `setCompactWord` and `GetBitsProof`.
- [x] **Assumevalid model omits Core gates.** `AF/PDW46/PDW46.lean:308,415`: missing assumevalid hash/ancestor/best-header/chainwork gates; the `h < a` boundary also excludes the assumevalid block's own height.
- [x] **`min_pow_checked` model is too narrow.** `AF/PDW8/Blk122Cor.lean:138`: derives the flag from `nMinimumChainWork` alone; Core also uses near-tip work, candidate proof, and `GetAntiDoSWorkThreshold`.
- [x] **BIP9 timeout/threshold order is wrong.** `Bip/B08/Bip141Defs.lean:238` and `Bip141Tests.lean:212` test timeout before threshold; Core checks the signal count first (`.lockedIn`, not `.failed`).
- [x] **Annex hash omits the CompactSize prefix.** `AF/PDW77/PDW77.lean:83` and `AF/PDW41/TPR006.lean:43`: the key-path annex digest is raw SHA256; BIP341/Core hash `CompactSize(len) || annex`.
- [x] **INV-077 witness-unexpected case is missing.** `AF/PDW52/PDW52.lean:137`: `witnessUnexpected_nonWitness` assumes `flags.p2sh = false`, so it never covers the ordinary non-P2SH scriptPubKey under consensus flags.
- [x] **INV-043 op-count gate is BASE-only.** `AF/PDW88/PDW88.lean:17`: the theorem fixes `ctx.sv = .base`; `stepBody` also counts in WITNESS_V0.
- [x] **SCR-051 is policy-conditional, not consensus.** `AF/PDW98/PDW98.lean:161` and `AF/PDW95/PDW95b.lean:63` prove minimal operands only with `pol.minimalData = true`, while the row is marked `consensus: true`.
- [x] **PDW94 stackop underflow list is incomplete.** `AF/PDW94/PDW94.lean:25`: the theorem covers a 19-opcode whitelist, not every consuming opcode claimed by the header.
- [x] **Unexecuted IF omits the condition stack.** `AF/PDW85/PDW85b.lean:11`: conclusion only preserves `stack`/`alt`; the actual transition pushes `false` onto `vf`.
- [x] **Taproot commitment compares numerics, not bytes/length.** `AF/PDW56/PDW56.lean:112`: `bytesToNatBE` ignores length, so a 33-byte program with the same value is accepted; require `program.size = 32` and byte equality.
- [x] **SCR-149 is attached to the wrong witness branch.** `AF/PDW19/PDW19.lean:78`: tags the witness-version ≥2 branch (SCR-151) as SCR-149; retag and cover the taproot leaf-version branch.
- [x] **`taprootLane_consensus_pure` is vacuous.** `AF/PDW25/PDW25.lean:106`: the statement reduces to function congruence and does not express policy non-leakage.
- [x] **`RawOK` does not assert on-curve.** `AF/PDW42/PDW42.lean:75`: `liftX_on_curve_face` concludes only coordinate bounds; use `liftX_onCurve` or rename.
- [x] **`PubKeyMatrix` rows cannot kernel-reduce.** `EcdsaDeep/PubKeyMatrix.lean:410,846,936,960`: `by decide` on `sqrtP`/`expM` paths is stuck; move to the R6/admit set or use a reducible square root.
- [x] **`SmulCor` references a missing module.** `EcdsaDeep/SmulCor.lean:36`: claims `SmulCorIF.lean`/`MulPIF`/`SmulIF`; the file does not exist. Add it or remove the claims.
- [x] **INV-119 MuHash is only Nat addition.** `AF/PDW21/PDW21.lean:46`: `muhashSet` is a `Nat` sum, not MuHash3072 group arithmetic. Either implement the group or add INV-119 to `RESIDUALS.md`.
- [x] **Wallet obligations are false as stated.** `Wallet/Obligations.lean:251` (empty `multi` expands successfully), `:554` (mixed height/time locks with `k = 1`), `:836` (unknown PSBT keys can survive finalization).
- [x] **Y12 block expectations are wrong.** `Property/Y12/FoldProps.lean:767,794`: D12 expects `.ok` where the model returns `badTxnsBIP30`; E_227931 claims BIP30 rejection but only proves same-block duplicate coinbases are accepted.
- [x] **Y15 witness-stack expectations are wrong.** `Property/Y15/WitnessProps.lean:496,511`: `fe01000002` yields `.truncated` (not `.compactSizeTooLong`), and `0201aa00` is a valid two-item stack.
- [x] **BIP144 output decode loses signedness.** `Bip/B10/Bip144.lean:110`: `rdVout` casts raw `Nat` to `Amount`; use `u64ToAmt` so negative int64 outputs decode as two's-complement negatives.
- [x] **`PDW47` codeseparator fold ignores execution.** `AF/PDW47/PDW47.lean:305`: records every `0xab` even in unexecuted branches; add an `fExec`/condition-stack mask.
- [x] **`PDW28` mainnet powLimit pin is the genesis target.** `AF/PDW28/PDW28.lean:58`: pins `2^224 - 2^208`, not Core's `2^224 - 1`; the corrected `powLimitMainnetFull` is unused.
- [x] **`PDW30` prune/status docs omit the failed block.** `AF/PDW30/PDW30b.lean:340,369`: the failed block is dropped and marked `BLOCK_FAILED_VALID`, not `BLOCK_FAILED_CHILD`.
- [x] **`PDW53` mutated-failure taxonomy over-rejects.** `AF/PDW53/PDW53.lean:10` depends on the unaligned `levelHasAdjacentDup`; update after fixing the detector.

## Medium / low — grouped cleanup

- [x] **Rule-tag mismatches.** Examples: SCR-149 vs SCR-151 (`PDW19`), SCR-091 on an OP_SIZE theorem (`PDW86`), INV-043 vs SCR-020 (`PDW73`), SCR-154 vs SCR-071 (`PDW89`), SCR-166 vs SCR-162 (`PDW47`). Re-run `rule_crosscheck` and correct tags/targets.
- [x] **Axiom pins are missing or unguarded.** Several modules claim "axiom-pinned in-file" without pins, or use bare `#print axioms` without `#guard_msgs`/expected footprints (e.g. `PDW58GuardsD`, `PDW58GuardsE`, `PDW4`, `PDW20`, `PDW25`). Add `#guard_msgs in #print axioms ...` with expected footprints.
- [x] **Stale source anchors and comment arithmetic.** Examples: `231,000` vs `2,310,000` sats (`Conservation/Thms.lean:382`, `PDW7/INV033...:104`), `77` vs `72` digits (`Crypto/CurveZMod.lean:17`), stale `Params.lean`/`Interface.lean` line refs.
- [x] **One-branch theorems with general doc claims.** Several `stepBody`/witness theorems fix `ctx.sv = .base` or one opcode while the comment claims all sigversions/opcodes (e.g. `PDW79` IFDUP/NUMEQUALVERIFY, `PDW88` OP_IF/NOTIF, `PDW94`, `PDW98`).
- [x] **Build disclosure is incomplete.** `docs/PROOF-BUILD.md` names 4 public failures but not all 20; reconcile the failing-module list and ensure every cited row target is in a passing build (notably `Theorems.Ops.O07` / SCR-100).
- [x] **Medium edge-case definitions.** `PDW24` powLimit gate, `PDW21` `UInt32` height wrap at `2^32`, `PDW56` byte-length compare, `BIP144` signed output, `PDW42` `RawOK`, `PDW47` codesep execution.
- [x] **Low-severity doc corrections.** Wrong opcode comments (`0xad` vs `0xac`), wrong fixture spans (BIP94 `+1`), stale theorem counts, wrong Base58/DER comments, and off-by-one comment ranges.

## Verification / tracking

- [x] Re-run `make gates` after the fixes.
- [x] Build all 410 proof modules individually and update `docs/PROOF-BUILD.md` with the exact pass/fail list.
- [x] Re-run the dynamic consensus and wallet axiom probes after changing definitions/theorems.
- [x] Update `docs/RESIDUALS.md` for any gap that is accepted rather than fixed.
- [x] Add regression vectors for each consensus-semantics fix (median time, castToBool negative zero, witness commitment reserved value, BIP30, findAndDelete, merkle duplicate detection, taproot q-binding).

## Audit metadata

- Reviewers: 128 (partitioned across all 408 modules; 36 reported no new findings).
- Findings: 1 critical / 46 high / 50 medium / 88 low.
- Static gates: 9/9 passed before the audit.
- Note: severity is reviewer-assigned; "confirmed" means the source contradiction was re-read. Reviewer-reported items may include duplicates or already-documented residuals.

comments.body:
I’ve triaged the actionable findings into eight independent repair areas. Each area will confirm reviewer-reported items in source before changing semantics, add a regression where the fix is behavioural, and record accepted gaps in `docs/RESIDUALS.md` rather than silently dropping them.

1. **Block, Merkle, BIP30, BIP113, BIP144** — median-time-past upper median; pair-aligned CVE-2012-2459 duplicate detection; reserved witness commitment; `validateBlock` BIP30 gate; signed BIP144 outputs.
2. **Interpreter and script semantics** — `findAndDelete` suffix; PDW59/PDW79/PDW85/PDW88/PDW94/PDW95/PDW98/PDW47/PDW29 claims, tags, and policy boundaries.
3. **Taproot, BIP141/BIP9, annex, crypto** — q-binding/program check; `castToBool` negative zero; BIP9 order; CompactSize annex hash; PDW19/21/25/42/52/56/77 and Z29.
4. **PoW, chainwork, assumevalid, prune** — PDW24/PDW28/PDW30/PDW46/PDW8/PDW51 definitions and expectations.
5. **Critical proof/property mismatches** — Y08/Y09 `one256`; Y03 `native_decide`; Y12/Y15 expectations; Z21; `MerkleShapes64`.
6. **Wallet** — selection determinism; hash-lock acceptance; obligation statements; `ScriptExact`/`Expand` totality.
7. **Tags, axiom pins, comments, low-severity cleanup** — rule-tag corrections, guarded axiom footprints, stale anchors/arithmetic, opcode/doc corrections in the affected modules.
8. **Build and verification** — repair or narrow the failing `SmallCurve`, `PubKeyCor`, `PubKeyMatrix`, `SmulCor`, `O07`, and `FuelStability` claims; replace the incomplete build disclosure with the exact per-module result; reconcile residuals and proof counts.

The release tag and its payload remain unchanged. I’ll update the checkboxes only when a fix is actually on `main`, not when a patch is merely proposed.

All checkboxes are now checked on `main` at `80bf09b5dd7de4f6f879671cc0b93c30a4e89dc2`.

Merged repair PRs: #9 (AF tags/axioms/anchors), #10 (wallet), #11 (PoW/chain), #12 (interpreter/script), #14 (taproot/BIP141/BIP9/annex), #15 (block/Merkle/BIP30/BIP144), #17 (proof build and residuals), #18 (critical proof/property mismatches), and #19 (accurate P2SH/P2WSH sigops), plus small public hygiene/count commits.

Final verification on `main`:

- `make gates`: all nine static gates pass.
- `extract_rules.py --check`: 726 YAML rows, 726 regenerated rows, 0 field drift.
- `theorem_index.py --check`, `proof_scope.py --check`, and `residuals_index.py --check` pass.
- `cd spec/proofs && lake build BitcoinProofs`: 1722 jobs, success (29-module default closure).
- Outside-closure status is now 372 pass / 8 fail over the 380 modules; the eight failures are uncited and listed in `docs/PROOF-BUILD.md`. The previously cited `Theorems.Ops.O07` target builds.
- Consensus axiom probe: `axiom_manifest.sh` OK (223 entries / 237 manifest lines; no `sorryAx` or native/compiler-trust markers in the probed surface).
- Wallet axiom probe: `wallet_axiom_manifest.sh --probe` OK (838 declarations; permitted axioms only).

Accepted gaps are documented instead of hidden: `docs/RESIDUALS.md` now records 27 consensus residuals (including the accepted MuHash3072 abstraction), and `docs/AUDIT-RESIDUALS.md` records the proof-surface claim reductions. `docs/REGRESSION-VECTORS.md` lists the vectors for the consensus-semantics fixes.

The data release tag `data-2026.10.17` is unchanged at `4f5c4f858fb9ca0743042644453cfa92d30dd271`.

title: Audit: 128-reviewer proof-set review — correctness and Core-fidelity findings
